proof_body:
by
  intro n k p hk hp hp1
  have hq : 0 < 1 - p := by linarith
  have hc : ((n.choose (k + 1) : ℝ)) * ((k : ℝ) + 1) = (n.choose k : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - k) := by
    have := Nat.choose_succ_right_eq n k
    have h2 : ((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) - k := by rw [Nat.cast_sub hk.le]
    rw [← h2]
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hC : (0 : ℝ) < n.choose k := by exact_mod_cast Nat.choose_pos hk.le
  have hk1 : (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
  have hnk : n - k = (n - (k + 1)) + 1 := by omega
  rw [hnk, pow_succ (1 - p), pow_succ p]
  have hpos : 0 < p ^ k * (1 - p) ^ (n - (k + 1)) := by positivity
  have e1 : (n.choose k : ℝ) * p ^ k * ((1 - p) ^ (n - (k + 1)) * (1 - p)) = (p ^ k * (1 - p) ^ (n - (k + 1))) * ((n.choose k : ℝ) * (1 - p)) := by ring
  have e2 : (n.choose (k + 1) : ℝ) * (p ^ k * p) * (1 - p) ^ (n - (k + 1)) = (p ^ k * (1 - p) ^ (n - (k + 1))) * ((n.choose (k + 1) : ℝ) * p) := by ring
  rw [e1, e2, mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hpos]
  have hc2 : (n.choose (k + 1) : ℝ) = (n.choose k : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - k) / ((k : ℝ) + 1) := by
    field_simp; linarith
  rw [hc2, div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ hk1]
  have : (n.choose k : ℝ) * (1 - p) * ((k : ℝ) + 1) ≤ (n.choose k : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - k) * p ↔ (n.choose k : ℝ) * ((1 - p) * ((k : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ (n.choose k : ℝ) * (((n : ℝ) - k) * p) := by
    constructor <;> intro h <;> nlinarith
  rw [this, mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hC]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> nlinarith
